$provenance.sourceWorkbook: Ultimate Annual Budget ("Workbook"), the owner's copy, Google Sheets export (not committed)

cells.planHistory: Bills!B7:D7, F7:H7, J7:L7 (Day Paid, name, Monthly Amount); every other Day Paid and Monthly Amount in B8:D29, F8:H29, J8:L29 is blank
cells.categories: START HERE!B18:B24, D18:D21, F18:F20, as Bills!C7:C13, G7:G10, K7:K9 read them

$provenance.note: Workbook's sample data, not the owner's. Read with openpyxl data_only=True (cached values). Plan S9, workbook-bills: the total tiles under the Bills tab's three cards.

$semantics.totals: D32 =SUM(D7:D29), H32 =SUM(H7:H29), L32 =SUM(L7:L29): every Monthly Amount on the card; a blank adds nothing. The tiles are formatted "$"#,##0, so L32 shows $18, but the cached value keeps its cents, and so does the app (D8).
$semantics.planHistory: D13. Workbook has one Monthly Amount for every month tab (Jan!E22 and Dec!E22 both read Bills!D7). Each amount typed is a row from Jan!D7's month, 2026-01, and each total is asked in January and in December (Dec!D7), the first and last month tabs that read it. A blank Monthly Amount is no row; a blank Day Paid would be a null dueDay.
$semantics.departures: D7: H36, 'Fixed Monthly Bills', =SUM(D32,H32,G46) reads the empty G46 and so drops the Subscriptions total. The app's all-fixed total is D32 + H32 + L32. The cached value is kept here only to show the app departs from it; it is never asserted as expected.
$semantics.sample: One amount per card, so each cached total is a single-addend sum; hand-derived multi-row totals are in packages/core/test/plans.test.ts.
$semantics.merchants: The engine takes no merchant text. Ids are synthetic.
